images.caption:
Taken with Sigma DP1.
Processed with SPP > Lightroom > PS.
This could be the very first photo i took with my Sigma DP1, back in what ever year that was, 2010 i think.
I'm planning to buy a Sigma SD1 as my next camera, so i've been revisiting some of my DP1 shots and have been really impressed with what this little camera was capable of.
There was no additional sharpening of this pic.

Be sure to view full size.
